title: Do Women Like The Dad Bod?
hook: Women say they like the dad bod, but what do they mean by that?
body: In this ManVsStreet interview, she says she's game for the dad bod. But when he shows her a picture of Seth Rogen, he's probably not her thing. She wants someone strong who still takes care of himself. So women have a different definition of dad bod than what me and you do. They're talking about someone more like Daniel Craig as James Bond. Someone who's lean, where you can see his abs, but he's not necessarily jacked like a bodybuilder.
